audience.en: A 23-year-old French graduate in Toulouse with EUR 44,000 (EUR 38,000 from family plus EUR 6,000 of her own), weighing a one-year UK master's from September 2027 in Manchester or London: visa rules, costs and the Graduate route.
audience.fr: Une jeune diplômée française de 23 ans à Toulouse, avec EUR 44 000 (EUR 38 000 de sa famille et EUR 6 000 à elle), qui hésite sur un master d’un an au Royaume-Uni dès septembre 2027 à Manchester ou à Londres : règles de visa, coûts et Graduate route.

localeReason: French serves this decision directly: Léa is a French citizen living in Toulouse, her family money is in euros, and she must read the GOV.UK Student-visa and Graduate-route conditions, the euro-to-pound shortfall and the open issues in her own language before paying any deposit. It changes no rule, fee, rate or date.

planningAssumptions.person: Léa, 23, French citizen in Toulouse, EUR 44,000 (EUR 38,000 family plus EUR 6,000 own), one-year master's from September 2027.
planningAssumptions.fx: ECB reference rate on 6 November 2026: EUR 1 = GBP 0.83415, so GBP 1 = EUR 1.1988; October 2026 range GBP 0.8338 to GBP 0.8537 per EUR 1. EUR 44,000 = £36,702.60.
planningAssumptions.budget: Tuition + Student visa fee £558 + IHS £1,164 + university living-cost estimate for 12 months (Manchester £18,188; King's £21,240). IHS assumes a 16-month visa (£776 + £388) and is unconfirmed; flights, laptop, deposit, insurance, 2027/28 price rises and Graduate-visa costs are not included.
planningAssumptions.programmes: Five illustrative examples: Alliance MBS IBM £34,800, Manchester Econ & DS £35,300, MMU Data Science £21,000 (course length and fee year not confirmed), LSE Data Science £41,900, KCL Data Science £42,900.

datePolicy: All pages were read on 2026-11-08 in the original run and that access date is kept. Page dates, fee years and deadlines are source dates, not access dates. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: The IHS amount assumes a 16-month Student visa for a 12-month master's (£776 + £388 = £1,164); the visa-length rule was not read. If the visa were 12 months or less, IHS would be £776 and every total £388 lower. Unconfirmed.
MMU MSc Data Science: course length and fee year were not confirmed; £21,000 is the typical annual overseas fee on the page for a September 2027 start.

Living-cost estimates are 2026/27 and rents were seen on one day; 2027/28 prices will probably be higher (not quantified). Manchester's £18,188 comes from a page on its postgraduate-research site that also covers taught master's; applying it to a taught master's is an assumption.
GREAT Scholarships 2027-28 list not confirmed (2026-27 only); no scholarship is guaranteed. LSE Graduate Support Scheme 2027/28 application only 'expected to open in late November 2026'.

ATAS exemption for French nationals not verified; whether a deposit counts toward visa funds not checked; no finding on any 2027 change to Student-visa fees or a student levy. A degree taught in French not being accepted as English proof is a reading of the list, unconfirmed.

Not found: UCL (HTTP 403) and Imperial fees, a London business master's fee, 2027/28 hall prices, an ONS Manchester rent figure, TfL Travelcard prices. Rent listings, the Turing statement and the French bourse reading are unconfirmed. Whether a job could sponsor a Skilled Worker visa after the Graduate route was not researched.
The Graduate visa is 18 months for applications on or after 1 January 2027 (2 years on or before 31 December 2026); the rules and fees may change again before 2028.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Local files only. The README locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE were read first, then the run's index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md. No network research, build or publication during authoring. The French page was translated from the English guide.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: The original research used plain fetch and search; some scholarship pages (chevening.org, study-uk.britishcouncil.org, britishcouncil.fr, marshallscholarship.org, ucl.ac.uk/scholarships) were read through a managed headless browser with no sign-ins. UCL pages returned HTTP 403 and were not bypassed.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: A recheck recomputed every money figure with no wrong amount; it corrected the Graduate total conversion from about EUR 2,985 to about EUR 2,984, asked for the French-degree English point to be marked as an inference, the Erasmus+ timing to read 'second half of 2027 at the earliest', and the Manchester living-cost page's research-student scope to be noted. The run does not say who performed the recheck; the guide does not claim it was an outside person.
